title: Buying a ninety-nine dollar saxophone; costume, singing and dancing
summary: Doc Moon bought Joe a Conn alto sax in Lafayette to be repaid at two dollars a week, and Joe asked for a Six Brown Brothers style costume and added singing and dancing.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Reeds, mouthpieces and horns: the reed player's gear

blocks.x: Oh, lord, that was high in those days.
Ninety-dollars. A nickel-plated one.
Was it high do you think because they didn't have too many saxophones around in the South, or...?
Darensbourg - 70
Well, the smaller the town is, the more they would cost you, you know. If I went to Baton Rouge maybe or New Orleans, I could probably have got one a little cheaper than that.
That's a heck of a price. Lord! I mean, ninety-nine dollars in those days, good God...

It was a lot of money, but Doctor Moon said, 'You can pay me back two dollars a week.' I said, 'Okay,' and that's when I started playing. And I said, 'But I want a costume. I want you to fix me a costume like Tom Brown of Six Brown Brothers.' Do you remember the Six Brown Brothers, the saxophone sextet?
No.
It was a big act on the Orpheum Circuit. And they would dress like clowns, with great big toppers(?), you know, and little hats on...
Were all of Doctor Moon's people dressed in costume?
Doctor Moon dressed in a tuxedo, like, with a great big white flower on his lapel, and sometimes he wore a top hat.
What about the musicians?
Well, some of them would have maybe overalls on or something. He never had no special costume
Darensbourg - 71
for them. But they wore a nice suit maybe or something. But I wanted this... I kind of liked that costume, because I wanted to look different.
I guess you would in that!
Yeah. And then Doc Moon said, "Can you sing a little?" I said, "Sure. Sure, I can sing. And I can dance, too."
Oh, you danced?
Yeah! [LAUGHS]
Or you just told him you could.
I'd get up there and do a couple of little time steps I could do.
Like a buck dance and all that kind of stuff.
